premises.text: Customers face inefficiencies in finding last-minute personal services.
premises.evidence_span: it seemed really inefficient that I had to go through the painful process of dialing all of those merchants just to find one that was willing to take my money

premises.text: Bidzee allows customers to request personal services and name their own price.
premises.evidence_span: you can easily place a request for personal service, and you can even name your own price

premises.text: Merchants can accept bids from customers without upfront investment.
premises.evidence_span: A merchant working with Bidzee faces no upfront investment at all

premises.text: Merchants have certainty and immediacy of when the service is expected.
premises.evidence_span: they have certainty and immediacy of when the service is expected

premises.text: Bidzee connects customers with verified local businesses for services.
premises.evidence_span: Bidzee is only connecting you with a verified, rated local business in order to perform the service

premises.text: Local service merchants are desperate for effective customer acquisition channels.
premises.evidence_span: local service merchants are desperate for channels of customer acquisition

premises.text: Bidzee allows merchants to accept bids only when they have excess capacity.
premises.evidence_span: Bidzee merchants only need to accept bids when they know they have excess capacity

value.text: Customers get personal services on their terms while merchants monetize idle time.
value.evidence_span: A customer gets an appointment on their terms, and a business gets a paying customer through the door, allowing them to monetize otherwise idle time

notes: No separate premises for customer acquisition channels as they all relate to the same need.
